test.create_query: CREATE TABLE promql_topk_tags ( id UInt64, metric_name LowCardinality(String), tags Map(LowCardinality(String), String), min_time DateTime64(3), max_time DateTime64(3) ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id
CREATE TABLE promql_topk_samples ( id UInt64, timestamp DateTime64(3), value Float64 ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (id, timestamp)
CREATE TABLE promql_topk_ts ENGINE = TimeSeries SAMPLES promql_topk_samples TAGS promql_topk_tags
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO promql_topk_tags (id, metric_name, tags, min_time, max_time) SELECT number + 1, 'load', map('instance', toString(number), 'dc', toString(number % 10)), toDateTime64(0, 3), toDateTime64(10000, 3) FROM numbers(4000)
INSERT INTO promql_topk_samples (id, timestamp, value) SELECT (number % 4000) + 1, toDateTime64(100 + intDiv(number, 4000) * 10, 3), (sipHash64(number) % 1000000) / 1000 FROM numbers_mt(4000 * 300)
